'''Espa Heights''' was located in [[Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. It consisted primarily of residential structures typical of that area of the [[City/Legends|city]], including domed houses arranged around central courtyards.<ref name="TG" />

[[Kitster Chanchani Banai]] had a [[Banai house|house]] located within Espa Heights. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], during an [[Mission to Tatooine (Killik Twilight)|incident]] involving [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] member [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and her companions, the group approached the Banai household in search of Kitster.<ref name="TG" />
